name: liveclass
description: LiveClass AI — 실시간 라이브 강의 플랫폼 (루트 통합 실행: frontend + backend)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n FE,BE,WATCH -c green,blue,magenta "npm run fe:dev" "npm run be:dev" "npm run be:watch"
scripts.start: npm run build:fe && cd backend && .\gradlew.bat bootRun
scripts.dev:wsl: concurrently -k -n FE,BE,WATCH -c green,blue,magenta "npm run fe:dev" "npm run be:dev:wsl" "npm run be:watch:wsl"
scripts.start:wsl: npm run build:fe && cd backend && ./gradlew bootRun
